private_lines.Amira: You work as a graphic designer from a studio in central Tunis, and you share a flat in Lafayette with Fares. Your days are mostly desk work and client emails, with a weekly lunch at your parents' house.

private_lines.Maram: You work as a marketing assistant at an agency in Tunis, and you live alone in a rented flat in Menzah. Your days are office hours, with the gym after work and weekends spent with friends.
private_lines.Noureddine: You are a retired teacher living in Tunis with your wife. Your mornings are spent at the café with old friends, your afternoons in the garden or with a book.
private_lines.Najet: You are a retired nurse living in Tunis with your husband. Your days are full of visits from grandchildren, errands in the neighbourhood and time with family.
private_lines.Iyed: You are a lawyer working in Tunis, and you live alone in an apartment near the lake. Your days are long court and office hours, and your evenings are usually spent working or relaxing alone.
